title: Comprehensive Annual Maintenance 4C Contract Charges of Monochrome and Colour Digital Multifunctional Printer at Deep Bhavan, Cochin
summary: Offline sealed quotation for a one-year comprehensive 4C (consumables, spares, service) annual maintenance contract, paid per copy, for two Ricoh digital multifunctional printers at Deep Bhavan, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin-682020
sites.work: Comprehensive 4C AMC of two digital multifunctional printers

scope.item: Comprehensive annual maintenance 4C contract of Ricoh MP 3554 SP monochrome digital multifunctional printer (print/scan/copy); one year; monthly payment per print/copy
Comprehensive annual maintenance 4C contract of Ricoh MP C2011 colour digital multifunctional printer (print/scan/copy), per colour print/copy; one year; monthly payment
Comprehensive annual maintenance 4C contract of Ricoh MP C2011, per black & white print/copy

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. Rates to show basic cost and taxes separately; L1 on consolidated lowest total. Monthly payment within 15 days of satisfactory performance. Penalty 5% on upcoming bill for restoration delay above 24 hours.

period.completion: One year contract, active from date of work/supply order
period.bid_validity: 1 year from date of opening of quotations

eligibility: Reputed OEM or authorized suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties, shops or Government undertakings
Local registered office in Ernakulam District, Kerala (GST certificate mandatory)
specs: 4C contract covers all consumables (colour/black toner, drum, developer), spares and service; monthly routine and preventive maintenance visit
Breakdown attendance within 4 hours; maximum parts replacement lead time 48 hours
Printers: Ricoh MP 3554 SP (monochrome) and Ricoh MP C2011 (colour)
notes: Scanned NIQ (dated 25.04.2025), scope, terms and blank schedule. Download 29.04.2025 (09:00) to 06.05.2025 (15:00); submission 29.04.2025 (14:00) to 06.05.2025 (15:00); opening 07.05.2025 (16:00). No copy volumes given in schedule. Schedule misprints 'Contact Period'.
